recommendation: Keep this focused source fix. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-5303 unless PA wants a broader cleanup of other Slot search parameter descriptions outside this ballot-comment scope.
issue_request: FHIR-5303 was a Published PA change request from the Jan 2015 ballot. It objected that Slot scope/usage text categorized slots as open, booked, or blocked while the SlotStatus value set used BUSY, FREE, BUSY-UNAVAILABLE, and BUSY-TENTATIVE; the accepted Persuasive with Modification resolution was to remove the v2-derived wording from Slot scope and usage.
initial_application: The historical application commit be470cb21da4107826991acb4bd95704746d88a2 removed the HL7 v2.7 block containing the open/booked/blocked wording from source/slot/slot-introduction.xml and changed SlotStatus wording from appointment-focused to slot-focused in the then-current Slot spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Slot is active in source/fhir.ini and current authoritative Slot status definitions in structuredefinition-Slot.xml, codesystem-slotstatus.xml, and valueset-slotstatus.xml already use the free/busy SlotStatus model. The remaining mismatch was source/slot/bundle-Slot-search-params.xml, where the active Slot-status search parameter still described Slot.status as the free/busy status of the appointment. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision for FHIR-5303.
reconciliation: Changed source/slot/bundle-Slot-search-params.xml so the Slot-status search parameter description says "The free/busy status of the slot."
source_changes: source/slot/bundle-Slot-search-params.xml: changed the Slot-status SearchParameter description from "The free/busy status of the appointment" to "The free/busy status of the slot".
